# Mountain Project

> > Comprehensive rock climbing and mountaineering route database covering climbing areas, route guides, and beta across North America and beyond.

Mountain Project is the leading online resource for climbers, featuring detailed information on climbing routes, areas, and conditions. The site covers major climbing destinations including Joshua Tree National Park, Zion National Park, Indian Creek, and the Needles of South Dakota, with contributions from climbers like Peter Gram, Greg Parker, and Mikel Madsen.

## Key Topics

- Rock climbing routes and beta
- Joshua Tree National Park
- Custer State Park climbing
- Indian Creek crack climbing
- Zion National Park
- Southwest Utah climbing
- South Dakota Needles
- Route guides and ratings
- Climbing area descriptions
- onX Backcountry integration
- Cathedral Spires
- Desert climbing
- Multi-pitch routes
- Trad and sport climbing

## California Climbing Areas

- [Rock Climbing in Disneyland Dome, Joshua Tree National Park](https://www.mountainproject.com/area/105720989/disneyland-dome): Disneyland Dome climbing area in Joshua Tree's Wonderland of Rocks
- [Rock Climbing in Rock Garden Valley, Joshua Tree National Park](https://www.mountainproject.com/area/105720684/rock-garden-valley): Rock Garden Valley climbing area in Joshua Tree's Lost Horse Area
- [Rock Climbing in The Brown Wall, Joshua Tree National Park](https://www.mountainproject.com/area/105720897/the-brown-wall): The Brown Wall in Joshua Tree's Real Hidden Valley climbing area
- [Rock Climbing in Super Creeps Wall, Joshua Tree National Park](https://www.mountainproject.com/area/105720831/super-creeps-wall): Super Creeps Wall in Joshua Tree's Lost Horse Area, California
- [Rock Climbing in Bronto Rock, Joshua Tree National Park](https://www.mountainproject.com/area/105720992/bronto-rock): Bronto Rock at Stirrup Tank in Joshua Tree's Pinto Basin area

## Utah Climbing Destinations

- [Rock Climbing in Desert Shield Buttress, Zion National Park](https://www.mountainproject.com/area/105717101/desert-shield-buttress): Desert Shield Buttress climbing area in Zion National Park, Utah
- [Rock Climbing in Battle of the Bulge Buttress, Indian Creek](https://www.mountainproject.com/area/105716883/battle-of-the-bulge-buttress): Battle of the Bulge Buttress in Indian Creek, Southeast Utah
- [Rock Climbing in South Sixshooter, Indian Creek](https://www.mountainproject.com/area/105716979/south-sixshooter): South Sixshooter climbing area in Indian Creek, Southeast Utah
- [Rock Climbing in West Canyon, Southwest Utah](https://www.mountainproject.com/area/105717182/west-canyon): West Canyon climbing in Snow Canyon State Park near Saint George
- [Rock Climbing in Chuckwalla Wall, Southwest Utah](https://www.mountainproject.com/area/105717173/chuckwalla-wall): Chuckwalla Wall climbing area near Saint George, Southwest Utah
- [Rock Climbing in Dead Mans Spires, San Rafael Swell](https://www.mountainproject.com/area/105717158/dead-mans-spires): Dead Mans Spires desert climbing in San Rafael Swell North, Utah

## South Dakota: Custer State Park

- [Rock Climbing in Khayyam Spire, Custer State Park](https://www.mountainproject.com/area/105714552/khayyam-spire): Khayyam Spire in Custer State Park's Cathedral Spires area
- [Rock Climbing in Spire One, Custer State Park](https://www.mountainproject.com/area/105714327/spire-one): Spire One in Custer State Park's Cathedral Spires, South Dakota
- [Rock Climbing in Sore Thumb, Custer State Park](https://www.mountainproject.com/area/105714630/sore-thumb): Sore Thumb spire climbing in Custer State Park's Needles Eye Area
- [Rock Climbing in Moby Dick, Custer State Park](https://www.mountainproject.com/area/105714664/moby-dick): Moby Dick formation in Custer State Park's Tenpins/Switchbacks area
- [Rock Climbing in Seashell, Custer State Park](https://www.mountainproject.com/area/105714567/seashell): Seashell spire with 5.10-5.12 bolted routes in Custer State Park

## South Dakota: Needles of Rushmore

- [Climbing in Iron Mountain, The Needles Of Rushmore](https://www.mountainproject.com/area/105714285/iron-mountain): Iron Mountain face climbing in South Dakota's Needles of Rushmore
- [Rock Climbing in South Seas, The Needles Of Rushmore](https://www.mountainproject.com/area/105714249/south-seas): South Seas climbing area in Needles of Rushmore near Mount Rushmore
- [Rock Climbing in Marker, The Needles Of Rushmore](https://www.mountainproject.com/area/105714261/marker): Marker climbing area near Magna Carta in Needles of Rushmore
- [Climbing in Crow Peak, Crow Peak](https://www.mountainproject.com/area/105714309/crow-peak): Crow Peak ice climbing area near Spearfish Canyon, South Dakota
